candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, causing gateway /v1/checkout to fail with 502; traces show order 500s as the proximate failure.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause of the order 500 (db pool, redis, payment latency) is not established; gateway logs excluded and no order-side telemetry admitted.

report.explanation: Gateway traces show checkout 502s driven by order POST /v1/orders returning 500; metrics confirm elevated 502s on /v1/checkout. The specific downstream cause within order is not yet evidenced, so the bounded candidate is the observed HTTP 500 failure.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/traces for the 500 responses to identify the failing dependency
Order-side dependency metrics (postgresql, payment, inventory/redis) during the incident window
